{"number":1075,"title":"bug: `naturo browser launch` omits --remote-allow-origins → launched browser rejects naturo\u0026#39;s own CDP connection (Chrome 111+)","body":"## Symptom\n`naturo browser launch` starts Chrome successfully, but **every subsequent browser command fails** to connect on a modern Chrome (111+):\n\n```\n$ naturo browser launch --headless --user-data-dir ./p\nChrome launched (pid=..., port=9222)\n$ naturo browser navigate http://127.0.0.1:PORT/page.html\n{\u0026#34;success\u0026#34;: false, \u0026#34;error\u0026#34;: {\u0026#34;code\u0026#34;: \u0026#34;BROWSER_CONNECTION_ERROR\u0026#34;,\n \u0026#34;message\u0026#34;: \u0026#34;... Handshake status 403 Forbidden ... Rejected an incoming WebSocket\n connection from the http://localhost:9222 origin. Use the command line flag\n --remote-allow-origins=http://localhost:9222 to allow connections from this origin\n or --remote-allow-origins=* to allow all origins.\u0026#34;}}\n```\n\n## Root cause\nSince Chrome 111, the DevTools endpoint rejects WebSocket upgrades whose `Origin` header is not explicitly allowed via `--remote-allow-origins`. `naturo/browser/_launcher.py::launch_chrome` builds the Chrome argv with `--remote-debugging-port` but **never adds `--remote-allow-origins`**, so the browser it launches is unconnectable by naturo\u0026#39;s own CDP client. (The recognition benchmark harness and the Electron fixture already pass `--remote-allow-origins=*`; the user-facing `browser launch` path does not.)\n\n## Impact\nThis breaks the entire browser-automation moat end-to-end whenever the user relies on `naturo browser launch` (the documented happy path, including the DrissionPage→naturo migration story #763/#1063). DrissionPage and Playwright both set this flag automatically; naturo must too.\n\n## Fix\nAdd `--remote-allow-origins=*` to the launch argv in `launch_chrome` (single chokepoint → fixes CLI launch, `--stealth`, and programmatic callers). Verified locally: with the flag, `launch → navigate → find` round-trips correctly against an offline fixture (3/3 elements found).\n\n## Acceptance\n- `launch_chrome` argv contains `--remote-allow-origins=*` (unit regression).\n- A real headless-Chrome `launch → navigate → find` round-trip succeeds (desktop test).\n\n**[Dev-Sirius]**","state":"closed","state_reason":"completed","html_url":"https://github.com/AcePeak/naturo/issues/1075","user":{"login":"AcePeak","id":10205779,"profile_url":"https://github.com/AcePeak","avatar_url":"https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/10205779?v=4"},"author_association":"OWNER","labels":["bug","P1","verified","status:done"],"assignees":["AcePeak"],"milestone":"v0.3.2","comments":2,"reactions":{"total_count":0,"+1":0,"-1":0,"laugh":0,"confused":0,"heart":0,"hooray":0,"rocket":0,"eyes":0},"created_at":"2026-06-20T10:14:13Z","updated_at":"2026-06-20T10:40:34Z","closed_at":"2026-06-20T10:40:34Z","closed_by":"AcePeak","has_parent":false,"has_children":false}
